name: Straddling and/or Overriding Mitral Valve

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Echocardiographic and Surgical Diagnostic Criteria for Straddling and/or Overriding Mitral Valve

criteria.description: Visualization of mitral valve chordae crossing the interventricular septum attaching to the right ventricle
Mitral valve annulus overriding the interventricular septum with dual ventricular inflow
Presence of associated congenital heart defects such as ventricular septal defect or double outlet right ventricle

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of echocardiographic evidence of mitral valve chordae straddling or overriding the interventricular septum with or without associated congenital cardiac anomalies
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on echocardiographic and surgical findings; cardiac MRI may be adjunctive.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Mitral valve chordae straddling interventricular septum
searchTerms: mitral valve strands crossing heart septum

pathognomonic.symptomName: Overriding mitral valve with dual ventricular inflow
searchTerms: mitral valve positioned over both ventricles
dual blood inflow through mitral valve

common.notes: Due to volume overload and valve dysfunction

common.symptomName: Systolic murmur due to mitral regurgitation
searchTerms: heart murmur from mitral valve leaking
systolic murmur due to mitral regurgitation
leaky mitral valve causing heart sound

rare.notes: Rare embolic events due to abnormal flow

laboratory: Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) in heart failure
Possible mild hypoxemia on arterial blood gas if cyanosis present
imaging: Echocardiography showing mitral valve chordae straddling or overriding the septum
Cardiac MRI confirming valve anatomy and associated defects
Chest X-ray showing cardiomegaly and pulmonary congestion
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; may be associated with complex congenital heart disease syndromes
other: Surgical findings confirming valve straddling or overriding
Electrocardiogram may show arrhythmias or ventricular hypertrophy

distinguishingFeatures: Common atrioventricular valve with a single annulus
Absence of mitral valve chordae straddling
Leaflet displacement into left atrium without chordae straddling

redFlags: Severe mitral regurgitation causing heart failure
references: Anderson RH, et al. The anatomy of straddling and overriding mitral valve. Cardiol Young. 2018.
Mavroudis C, Backer CL. Pediatric Cardiac Surgery. 4th ed. 2013.
Orphanet: Straddling and/or Overriding Mitral Valve. ORPHA:99064.
